_doc: Arenas (one per stop of the run). backdrop is under assets/arenas/.

arenas.name: The Shore of the Acheron
arenas.intro: Past the gate, the souls who never chose crowd the riverbank. Charon will not ferry the living.
arenas.art: wide panoramic view of the dark shore of the river Acheron in Hell, endless crowd of pale naked souls waiting on the rocky bank on the left and right, a wide calm black river across the middle of the image, the ancient ferryman Charon in a small boat with a glowing lantern far away on the water, distant cliffs under a starless sky with a faint red glow
